title: Positive Maps and Multipartite Bound Entanglement
exact_target: Extend the report's family of positive maps and determine how the associated Bell-diagonal states can exhibit detectable bound entanglement.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000180 (OWR-785-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Entanglement and Decoherence: Mathematics and Physics of Quantum Information and Computation (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/04, pp. 185--255; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 48--50, printed pages 232--234.
Horodecki et al., multipartite separability and positive maps; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The supplied positivity preamble omits the coefficient hypotheses on Lambda_1 that are needed for the source's proposition. An arbitrary Lambda_1 with large negative coefficients does not satisfy the stated conclusion. The primary source requires all coefficients of Lambda_1 to be positive and sufficiently large relative to the single negative coefficient of Lambda_2. This missing premise is explicitly restored in the source clarification.
